svg.aria-label: A lead-seal stamping press. A crown on two legs carries an arbor screw; below it a ram hangs a die head holding three dies — a round button, a toggle and a checkbox — over a lead band clamped to a carriage that rides two ways. The head's face is engraved with the three marks it strikes at once. Behind the press a board carries a rail with three places: two heads hang there on their own locating pins and the middle place is empty, because that head is on the press. On top, an arm on the screw points at a ring of index ticks.
